notes:
Candidate preparation for version 1.2.1 build 2. No App Review submission is requested yet and no App Store-capable build is selected. Build 1 is already available in internal-only TestFlight, uses Google sample advertising inventory and cannot be submitted to App Review.

The candidate supports applicable UMP privacy choices, optional iOS ATT/IDFA permission and permitted publisher-scoped identifiers. Ad requests remain behind current UMP eligibility and verified subscription state; consent to request an ad is not treated as consent to personalize or track. Refusing permissions keeps all tarot functions available. Regional choices are reopened in Settings > Advertising choices; iOS tracking permission is managed separately in device Settings. No banner appears during readings, contextual meanings or contextual tutorials. All seven existing monthly ad-removal subscriptions and their prices remain unchanged, with Restore and Manage Subscription available.

The public privacy policy distinguishes public version 1.2 (its existing non-personalized configuration) from the 1.2.1 candidate. App Privacy declares Device ID used for tracking for the optional IDFA path. The Tarot-specific English/Spanish IDFA explainer and US state privacy-options message are now published. In a controlled simulator experiment using the same UMP 3.1.0 path, both EEA and non-EEA missing-usage-description scenarios completed with real sample banners; an independent positive control displayed actual ATT. The app manifest now declares tracking and the two observed native advertising hosts; six real sample-consent/ATT simulator cases passed with that declaration. These tests are not a physical-device certification or an exact execution of the old released binary.

Before any App Review submission, select a separately verified public-capable build, reconcile the tracking manifest/domains, finish configured-message and physical-device QA, and replace these preparation notes with evidence for that exact release. SDKs: Google Mobile Ads 12.14.0 and UMP 3.1.0. No developer account login is needed. Readings, favorites and custom spread content remain on device.
